build_quadri_iou: build a python module to compute intersection-over-union between two sets of quadrilateral bounding boxes
build_quadri_iof: build a python module to compute intersection-over-foreground between two sets of quadrilateral bounding boxes
test_box_iou_quadri_aligned: test the box_iou_quadri function with aligned mode to compute pairwise IoU for matching quadrilateral boxes
test_box_iou_quadri_unaligned: test the box_iou_quadri function with unaligned mode to compute an NxM IoU matrix between two sets of quadrilateral boxes
review_box_iou_quadri: review the box_iou_quadri function that calculates IoU or IoF for quadrilateral bounding boxes using a CUDA extension
